title: Crash when opening shader editor
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]

Previously godot 4.6 stable, shader editor worked just fine.

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8247) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 265K (20 threads) - 47.27 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Whenever opening shader editor, godot will crash.
The shader itself worked fine so we can just make them with notepad.

### Steps to reproduce

Open Godot Editor,
Make new project,
Create new shader,
Crash.

The crash also happen if we open existing `.gdshader` file.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db08a449-8232-4017-96d4-79965319182e
